functions.criteria: Leading a political party or movement and setting its strategy. Incidental Politburo membership does not override a defining security, military, economic or propaganda career.

Cross-policy executive management and administrative coordination of a government or territory must define the career. A head-of-state, premier, deputy-premier, minister or regional-office title alone is insufficient. Prefer agriculture, economy, industry, diplomacy, law, security, military or another specific function when that field defines the career, including specialized ministers. Party or movement leadership belongs to political-leadership. Reigning monarchs, regents and royal consorts belong to monarchy. Ceremonial or nominal non-monarchical head-of-state office and presiding over a legislature belong to legislature; legislative membership and being a public official do not by themselves qualify. Never use government as a catch-all when evidence is unclear.

Presiding over a legislature or its presidium, or holding a ceremonial or nominal non-monarchical head-of-state office (such as a figurehead president), when that office defines the career and real executive power lay elsewhere. Ordinary legislative membership alone does not qualify. A head of state or premier who actually directed the executive belongs to government; leading a party or movement belongs to political-leadership. Monarchs, including constitutional monarchs, belong to monarchy.

Reigning as emperor, king, tsar, sultan, khan or another hereditary or enthroned monarch, including constitutional and puppet monarchs, ruling as regent, or serving as a royal consort whose court role defines the career. Royal birth alone does not qualify: a prince whose career was military command, party leadership or government office belongs to that function.
Military command, operations and organization. Intelligence and counterintelligence chiefs belong to security.
Intelligence, counterintelligence, policing and security administration. Being persecuted does not qualify.
Diplomats and international organization staff, including Comintern international work. Living abroad alone does not qualify.
Economic planning, finance, banking, trade and policy administration. Academic research alone belongs to scholarship.
Industrial administration, factory and armaments production management. Research and technical design belong to science.
Agricultural administration, land policy and agrarian organizing. Peasant origins alone do not qualify.
Party/state ideological administration, propaganda, censorship and cultural control. Independent creative work belongs to arts.

Labor, peasant, civic or underground political organizing, activism and resistance. Not a catch-all for everyone called a revolutionary or dissident. Running official mass organizations of a ruling system (Komsomol, official trade unions, state friendship societies) is not organizing.
Historical, social-scientific, philosophical and theoretical research. Legal scholarship and legal theory belong to law. Research subjects and citizenship are not political affiliations.
Teaching, school and university administration and education-policy administration. Research belongs to scholarship or science; ideological schooling of party cadres belongs to propaganda.
Natural science, engineering, medicine, research, development and technical design. An industry minister is not automatically a scientist.
Literary, visual, musical and performing arts. Administration of censorship belongs to propaganda.

Clergy, religious orders and church or religious-community leadership and administration. Faith, religious upbringing or persecution alone does not qualify; state control of religion belongs to propaganda or security.

Legal practice, defense counsel, prosecution, judging, judicial administration, and legal scholarship or legal theory, including constitutional and international law. A law degree alone does not qualify; being a defendant or victim alone does not qualify.
